Source: GLPI App Structure ID 860 + Dataflows. Fetched: 2026-06-01.

APPLICATION: BIBU
GLPI ID: 860
TYPE: Data Structure (ETL/BI data platform)
STATUS: In Use
DATABASE: SQL Server (source layer staging)
OWNER: OMDS IT > OMDG > BI and DevOps
USER: BrancoDa
TARGETS: Strategic, Confidential
SERVICE LEVEL: Critical 24x7
GITHUB REPO: OMDS-BIDevOps/OMDG_BIBU (Talend ETL jobs)

ROLE IN ARCHITECTURE:
BIBU is the central BI/BU data platform that acts as:
1. DATA INGESTION LAYER - pulls raw data from source systems into SQL Server staging (Source Layer)
2. DATA DISTRIBUTION HUB - sends processed data to operational systems
3. ETL ORCHESTRATOR - manages Talend jobs via OMDG_BIBU GitHub repository

INBOUND DATAFLOWS (systems feeding INTO BIBU - 9 flows):
- Adobe Commerce Cloud Magento -> BIBU: [MAGENTO]-[SL_APAC_SHOP] Extraction (ACTIVE)
- Adobe Commerce Cloud Magento -> BIBU: [MAGENTO]-[SL_EMEA_SHOP] Extraction (ACTIVE, partner: Scandiweb)
- Adobe Commerce Cloud Magento -> BIBU: [MAGENTO]-[SL_NALA_SHOP] Extraction (ACTIVE)
- MyOMSYSTEM -> BIBU: [MYOM]-[SL_01] Extraction (ACTIVE, partner: 4Roads)
- SAP CRM Marketing -> BIBU: [SAP OZP CRM]-[SL_SAP_MKT] Extraction (ACTIVE)
- SAP CRM Marketing -> BIBU: SAP_MKT > SAP_Base_Load I change (DEVEL)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> BIBU: [SAPERP_NEP]-[SL_SAPERP] Extraction (ACTIVE)
- SAP ERP NALA -> BIBU: [SAPERP_PE4]-[SL_SAPPE4] Extraction (ACTIVE)
- Service Tool -> BIBU: [ServiceTool]-[SL_ServiceTool] Extraction (ACTIVE, partner: Sprinx)

OUTBOUND DATAFLOWS (BIBU distributes TO - 16 flows):

- BIBU -> Office 365: [BIBU]-[EMAIL] Report STOLEN (ACTIVE)
- BIBU -> Office 365: [SAPERP_PE4]-[EMAIL] TRACKING SHIPMENT (ACTIVE)
- BIBU -> Webtech: [BIBU]-[CRM] BER_LOP (ACTIVE)
- BIBU -> Zendesk: [BIBU]-[ZENDESK] Customer Creation_Update (ACTIVE, partner: Redk)
- BIBU -> Zendesk: [BIBU]-[ZENDESK] Product Inf. Creation_Update (ACTIVE, partner: Redk)
- BIBU -> Zendesk: [BIBU]-[ZENDESK] Promo Inf. Creation_Update (ACTIVE, partner: Redk)

- BIBU -> Zendesk: [BIBU]-[ZENDESK] T_W Creation_Update (ACTIVE, partner: Redk)
- BIBU -> Zendesk: [BIBU]-[ZENDESK] Ticket Promotion Create (ACTIVE)
- BIBU -> Salesforce Marketing Cloud: [OMDS_EXT_SFMC]-[SFMC] Master export (ACTIVE) - Subscribe/Registration/Service/Warranty master data

- BIBU -> Report Server: [NIPPON]-[BIBU] Inventory Stock Sync (DEVEL)

KEY INTEGRATIONS:
- Zendesk: 6 active outbound flows (largest consumer of BIBU data)
- Magento: 3 regional extraction flows (APAC, EMEA, NALA)
- SAP ecosystem: multiple inbound (EMEA/NALA ERP + CRM) and outbound flows
- External partners: Scandiweb (Magento), Redk (Zendesk), 4Roads (MyOMSYSTEM), Sprinx (ServiceTool), Apisero/NTT Data (B2C)

topic: BIBU - Source Layer Architecture (Data Ingestion Pattern)
content:
Source: GLPI Dataflows analysis. Fetched: 2026-06-01.

BIBU uses a SOURCE LAYER pattern for data ingestion:
- Raw data is extracted from source systems and stored in SQL Server staging tables (called 'Source Layer' or 'SL_')
- Each source system has its own SL_ prefix naming convention:
  - SL_SAPERP = SAP ERP EMEA source layer
  - SL_SAPPE4 = SAP ERP NALA source layer
  - SL_SAP_MKT = SAP CRM Marketing source layer
  - SL_APAC_SHOP = Magento APAC source layer
  - SL_EMEA_SHOP = Magento EMEA source layer
  - SL_NALA_SHOP = Magento NALA source layer
  - SL_01 = MyOMSYSTEM source layer
  - SL_ServiceTool = Service Tool source layer

PROCESS MANAGERS (Talend orchestration):
- SL_HOURLY_PROCESSMANAGER - manages hourly extractions (Magento APAC, NALA)
- SL_DAILY_PROCESSMANAGER_EMEA - manages daily extractions (MyOMSYSTEM EMEA)

FLOW GROUPS:
- DATA PIPELINES - extraction/ingestion flows (BIBU as destination)
- INTEGRATION HUB - distribution flows (BIBU as source/orchestrator)

ETL TOOL: Talend Studio (jobs in GitHub repo OMDS-BIDevOps/OMDG_BIBU)
STAGING DB: SQL Server
